caption:
SENSEX SOARS 1,000 POINTS, NIFTY CROSSES 25,500

On 19 November 2026 the BSE Sensex jumped 989.94 points, about 1.21%, to close at 83,021.75. The Nifty crossed the 25,500 mark, a level not seen in nine months. The rally was led by auto and bank shares, supported by sustained foreign institutional buying and easing commodity prices, boosting market momentum.

For information only. Not investment advice.
